findings.title: Separate report persistence from oversized Store module
findings.why_it_matters: Maintainers changing report ordering or recognition persistence now work in the same 1,045-line module as private-directory identity checks, initialization recovery, and immutable-blob I/O. This delta grows the file from 855 lines by adding 264 and removing 74, crossing the review persona's explicit 1,000-line structural threshold. Moving the cohesive report/source persistence methods to a same-package file follows the existing deletion.go separation without introducing another abstraction or changing transaction boundaries.
findings.suggested_fix: Move CreateDraftSources and the report/source query, extraction, and review persistence methods into internal/library/reports.go within package library. Keep Store ownership, open/recovery, private-path checks, and original-file I/O in store.go; preserve the existing locking and transactions and run library/app tests after the mechanical split.
